Name: Sensor death and frozen traffic telemetry
Description: A downtown traffic counter freezes during rush hour while an industrial temperature sensor abruptly dies.
Expected: Twin: DTN-TRF-01 holds its pre-fault reported value (48) with status OK while its private actual input is 55; IND-TMP-01 reports null with status FAILED; registered backup IND-TMP-02 reports 70. A Brain-role command to IND-VLV-01 without backup context is rejected with SCENARIO_GUARDIAN_PENDING. With source_sensor_id IND-TMP-02, it passes that safety check but is rejected with UNSUPPORTED_DEVICE because IND-VLV-01 is not a supported actuator. CityCore revision and actuator state do not change.
Expected: Guardian: The Twin emits a pending marker for an untrusted sensor-linked command. No Guardian service or autonomous Guardian verdict is run by this scenario; real Guardian behavior is NOT VERIFIED.
Expected: Brain: No Brain service or autonomous Brain decision is run by this scenario. A controlled local Brain-role test call with the valid backup is still rejected because IND-VLV-01 is unsupported; no actuator fallback is claimed. Real Brain behavior is NOT VERIFIED.
How to verify: Run live_tests.test_scenario_orchestration.ScenarioOrchestrationTests.test_scn03_rejects_ambiguous_valve_even_with_valid_backup_sensor and tools/run_scenario_campaign.py. Inspect the SCN-03 scenario campaign JSON, Twin events, and audit log. The campaign commands are controlled local TwinFacade calls, not real partner responses.
